title: Atherosclerosis: From Pathogenesis to Therapeutic Interventions.
snippet: Atherosclerosis is no longer viewed solely as a lipid-storage disorder but rather as a complex multisystem inflammatory disease driven by interactions among the vascular, immune, metabolic, and nervous systems. title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell Therapy for Multiple Sclerosis: Harnessing Immunological Properties.
snippet: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic inflammatory autoimmune disease triggered by damage to the central nervous system (CNS). This CNS damage is caused by the attack of autoreactive T cells against the myelin sheath.
